prompt: The Telegram bridge queue watchdog sweep FAILED — the sweep itself errored, so dead claims may be stuck blocking their lanes. Do this: (1) verify the current state yourself — read ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/state.json (queue statuses, claim tokens, heartbeat_at values), the tail of ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/watchdog_recoveries.log, and the tail of ~/workspace/telegram-bridge/intake-errors.log. (2) If a claimed item's heartbeat is stale and its turn is gone, reconcile it by hand: release the orphaned claim (bridge_core.telegram --release UPDATE_ID CLAIM_TOKEN) so the intake's next poll re-claims it — never mark an unanswered item done, and never touch a 'sending' item without evidence of its send outcome. (3) Report the outcome briefly: what was stuck, what you freed, and whether the queue is moving again. Do not send any Telegram message yourself unless Westin asks for one.
